identity.title: Merchant accounts, memberships, sessions, roles and route policy

foreign_tables.app_packages: read: stays: identity.sql admits an app integration key only while its package is active with the same digest, inside the one authoritative credential snapshot (identity.sql)
foreign_tables.sales_channels: read: stays: identity.sql reads the request channel document inside the one authoritative credential snapshot (identity.sql)
foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: stays: identity.sql scopes the selected stage or preview to its live shop inside the one authoritative credential snapshot; agent authority and MFA resolve the live shop the same way (agent_authority.rs, identity.sql, mfa.rs)
foreign_tables.tenants: read: stays: identity.sql reads the live shop status inside the one authoritative credential snapshot; workspace lists and agent authority join shop status and names to memberships (agent_authority.rs, broker.rs, identity.sql, sessions.rs)

shop.title: Shop configuration, domains, legal texts and the operator control plane

foreign_tables.company_logos: write: stays: the sandbox copy and release copy company logos with the settings they belong to inside the staging transaction (staging.rs)
foreign_tables.company_overrides: write: stays: the sandbox copy and release copy per-channel company data with the channel settings inside the staging transaction; channel deletion counts them under the same lock (staging.rs, channel_settings.rs)
foreign_tables.sales_channels: read: stays: access_snapshot.sql and settings_snapshot.sql admit the request channel inside one statement with the shop status and settings; the operator list counts active channels with each shop page (access_snapshot.sql, operator_control.rs, operator_metrics.rs, settings.rs, settings_snapshot.sql)
foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: stays: access_snapshot.sql scopes a stage or preview to its live shop inside the request snapshot; operator views exclude sandboxes from live shops (access_snapshot.rs, access_snapshot.sql, operator_control.rs, operator_metrics.rs)
foreign_tables.tenants: write: stays: the access snapshot reads the live shop status in one statement; operator lifecycle locks and changes the status and status revision of a live shop next to the sandbox check (access_snapshot.rs, access_snapshot.sql, operator_control.rs, operator_metrics.rs)

catalog.title: Products, categories, media, reviews, translations and catalogue reads

foreign_tables.b2b_catalog: read: stays: the private unit catalogue scope filters inside the paginated catalogue, search and category queries so cursors and limits stay correct (catalog_channel.sql, catalog_reads.rs, catalog_search.sql, category_listing.sql)
foreign_tables.knowledge_documents: read: stays: category pages with a saved fact query select confirmed public claims inside the paginated listing (category_listing.sql)
foreign_tables.knowledge_relations: read: stays: category pages with a saved fact query select confirmed public claims inside the paginated listing (category_listing.sql)
foreign_tables.languages: read: stays: product translation reads join the global language registry to map locales inside the paginated or locked catalogue statement (app_references.rs, translation_runs.rs, workspace.rs, imported_lines/labels.sql)
foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: stays: the media job claim admits only jobs of active live shops inside its SKIP LOCKED claim statement (media_jobs.rs)
foreign_tables.tenants: read: stays: the media job claim admits only jobs of active live shops inside its SKIP LOCKED claim statement (media_jobs.rs)

foreign_tables.customer_sessions: read: reads the customer session to bind a buyer request to its account inside the same statement (buyer_identity.rs)
foreign_tables.customers: read: reads customer identity, group and company in the same statement as its own records to admit or project them (admin_order.rs, buyer_identity.rs, cart_create.rs, customer_snapshot.rs)
foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: reads the environment row (live shop, preview owner) to scope sandbox and preview requests to their live shop (buyer_identity.rs)
foreign_tables.tenants: read: reads shop existence, status or the agent stop switch inside a larger claim or join; simple reads go through veyndo_core::tenants (buyer_identity.rs)

foreign_tables.carts: read: stays: the customer's recent orders join their carts in one statement to match guest orders by the cart email (manual_orders.rs)
foreign_tables.orders: read: stays: the CRM detail and manual-order drafts read the customer's recent orders with the customer row in one statement (manual_orders.rs)

orders.title: Order state, fulfilment, receipts, documents and merchant order work

foreign_tables.carts: write: order mutations and notes mirror the order into the cart order snapshot the buyer reads (account_orders.rs, downloads.rs, order_list.rs, order_mutation.rs)
foreign_tables.order_downloads: read: reads download grants to project an order for the buyer (downloads.rs)
foreign_tables.product_assets: read: reads product asset metadata in the same statement as product rows (downloads.rs)
foreign_tables.sales_channels: read: reads the sales channel document (kind, activity, catalogue scope) to admit the request channel inside the same statement (company.rs, company_logos.rs)

payments.title: Provider-independent payment ledger, captures, refunds and provider workers

foreign_tables.app_packages: read: reads installed package manifests and their active flag to admit app-provided actions, tools or providers in the same transaction (capture_configuration.rs, provider_registry.rs, providers.rs, saved_instruments.rs)
foreign_tables.carts: write: payment commands and the ledger update the cart payment state under its lock (commands.rs, order_ledger.rs)
foreign_tables.orders: write: the payment ledger updates the order payment state (commands.rs, instructions.rs, order_ledger.rs, remote.rs)

marketing.title: Rules, coupons, promotions, flows and sales channels

foreign_tables.app_packages: read: stays: the configuration digest covers every installed app revision in one statement with rules, flows and promotions (configuration_digest.rs)
foreign_tables.commerce_overrides: read: stays: merchant reports read channel settings overrides inside the report snapshot transaction (report_channels.rs)
foreign_tables.tasks: read: stays: flow-template proposals check the task their flow job created, in one statement with the job lease (flow_proposal_reads.rs)

foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: the delivery and schedule claims exclude staging environments and resolve the live shop inside their single SKIP LOCKED claim statement (event_deliveries.rs, schedules.rs); other environment reads go through veyndo_core::store::previews, the preview expiry through the Directory port
foreign_tables.tenants: read: the delivery claim locks the owning shop row (FOR UPDATE OF d,owner SKIP LOCKED) and the schedule claim checks the live shop status inside the same claim statement (event_deliveries.rs, schedules.rs); other shop reads go through veyndo_core::store::tenants

intelligence.title: Shop memory, knowledge retrieval, agents, proposals and model inference

foreign_tables.app_evidence: read: the knowledge inventory counts merchant-private app evidence next to its own sources in one statement; the apps component owns ingestion and purge (documents.rs)
foreign_tables.app_packages: read: the knowledge inventory counts the active packages that contribute evidence in the same statement (documents.rs)
foreign_tables.channel_metrics: read: the shop overview and the planner facts read channel traffic counters next to learning state in one statement (overview.sql, personalization.rs)
foreign_tables.commerce_settings: read: hybrid search reads the shop's search weights inside the ranked retrieval statement (search.sql)
foreign_tables.customers: read: behaviour journeys join the identified customer in the consent-bound composed statement; entity checks of model evidence read customer existence (behavior.rs, product_reads.rs)
foreign_tables.exposures: write: storefront personalization records and reads experiment exposures; the shop overview counts them in its learning timeline (overview.sql, personalization.rs)
foreign_tables.orders: read: behaviour, experiment and overview statements aggregate orders next to their own observations; evidence checks read order existence (behavior.rs, experiments_report.sql, observations.rs, overview.sql, product_reads.rs)
foreign_tables.payment_attempts: read: experiment reports and price suggestions join payment attempts of the experiment's orders in one statement (experiments.rs, experiments_report.sql)
foreign_tables.privacy_consents: write: consent receipts are written and the shared consent filter joins them with behaviour events (behavior_eligible.sql, consent.rs)
foreign_tables.product_reviews: read: product facts and the knowledge inventory count published reviews in the same statement as their own records (documents.rs)
foreign_tables.products: write: retrieval, embeddings, relations and evidence join products inside their own statements; autonomy revert restores a price at the product revision (autonomy.rs, documents.rs, embedding_jobs.rs, relations.rs, search.sql, staging.rs and others)
foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: sandbox and preview requests resolve their live shop inside admission, claim and work statements; studio owns the table and depends on this component (agent_controls.rs, embedding_job_claim.sql, embedding_jobs.rs, product_reads.rs, scenario_reports.rs, vector_claim.sql, work_tasks.rs)
foreign_tables.tenants: read: embedding and vector claims join the shop row to skip inactive shops inside the claim statement (embedding_generations.rs, embedding_job_claim.sql, vector_claim.sql)
foreign_tables.translation_jobs: write: agent runs cancel the translation jobs they started and wake work tasks once their jobs stopped (agent_runs.rs, work_tasks.rs)

studio.title: Merchant overview, reports, private staging shops and history

foreign_tables.carts: read: the merchant report source joins each order's cart for its channel attribution in one read-snapshot statement (reports/source.sql)
foreign_tables.customers: read: the CRM directory page merges registered customers with guest order contacts in one keyset statement with optional filters and app extension predicates (customer_directory.sql, customer_directory_default.sql)
foreign_tables.merchant_users: read: history listings join the acting merchant's name to each recorded version in the same statement (history.rs)
foreign_tables.orders: read: the CRM directory page derives guest contacts from orders and the report source aggregates orders, each in one statement (customer_directory.sql, customer_directory_default.sql, reports/source.sql)
foreign_tables.payment_attempts: read: the report source joins refund and simulation state of each order's payment attempt in the same read-snapshot statement (reports/source.sql)
foreign_tables.sales_channels: read: the report source joins the channel kind of each order in the same read-snapshot statement (reports/source.sql)
foreign_tables.shop_environments: read: reads stages and previews of a live shop (list, count, baseline lock, preview checks, task and translation scopes); writes go through veyndo_core::store::environments_write (reports.rs, staging_clone.rs, staging_release.rs, tasks.rs, translation_runs.rs, workspaces.rs)
